name: learner_target_hours_current
definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (learner_target_hours_daily.learner_id) learner_target_hours_daily.learner_id,
            learner_target_hours_daily.enrolment_id,
            learner_target_hours_daily.aptem_id,
            learner_target_hours_daily.coach_email,
            learner_target_hours_daily.planned_hours,
            learner_target_hours_daily.start_date,
            learner_target_hours_daily.planned_end_date,
            learner_target_hours_daily.status,
            learner_target_hours_daily.status_reason,
            learner_target_hours_daily.formula_version,
            learner_target_hours_daily.calculation_method,
            learner_target_hours_daily.source_system,
            learner_target_hours_daily.source_reference,
            learner_target_hours_daily.calculated_by,
            learner_target_hours_daily.calculated_at,
            learner_target_hours_daily.updated_at,
            learner_target_hours_daily.as_of_date AS snapshot_date,
            learner_target_hours_daily.target_hours AS snapshot_target_hours
           FROM "Learner".learner_target_hours_daily
          ORDER BY learner_target_hours_daily.learner_id, learner_target_hours_daily.as_of_date DESC
        ), base AS (
         SELECT l.id AS learner_id,
            l.enrolment_id,
            l.aptem_id AS profile_aptem_id,
            l.coach_email::text AS coach_email,
            l.programme_status,
            l.lifecycle_status,
            l.planned_hours AS profile_planned_hours,
            l.start_date AS profile_start_date,
            l.end_date AS profile_end_date,
            l."Learner_Start_date" AS profile_learner_start_date,
            l."Learner_end_date" AS profile_learner_end_date,
            cu.aptem_id AS source_aptem_id,
            cu."Planned_hours" AS source_planned_hours,
            cu."Start_date" AS source_start_date,
            cu."End_date" AS source_end_date,
            cu."Learner_start_date" AS source_learner_start_date,
            cu."Learner_end_date" AS source_learner_end_date,
            cu."Apprenticeship_End_date" AS source_apprenticeship_end_date,
            cu."Practical_period_end_date" AS source_practical_end_date,
            d.aptem_id AS snapshot_aptem_id,
            d.planned_hours AS snapshot_planned_hours,
            d.start_date AS snapshot_start_date,
            d.planned_end_date AS snapshot_end_date,
            d.snapshot_date,
            d.snapshot_target_hours,
            d.formula_version,
            d.calculation_method,
            d.calculated_by,
            d.calculated_at,
            d.updated_at,
            ct.training_plan_planned_hours AS contract_training_plan_hours,
            ct.planned AS contract_planned_hours,
            ct.program_start_date::date AS contract_start_date,
            ct.planned_end_date::date AS contract_end_date
           FROM "Learner".learners l
             LEFT JOIN latest d ON d.learner_id = l.id
             LEFT JOIN enrolment."Created_users" cu ON cu.id = l.enrolment_id
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.training_plan_planned_hours,
                    c.planned,
                    c.program_start_date,
                    c.planned_end_date
                   FROM fetching_evidence.aptem_cv_contracts_probe c
                     LEFT JOIN "Audit".contract_document_archive a ON a.contract_id = c.id
                  WHERE c.learner_id =
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(l.aptem_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(cu.aptem_id, '<literal redacted>'::text)) ~ '<literal redacted>'::text THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(l.aptem_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(cu.aptem_id, '<literal redacted>'::text))::bigint
                            ELSE NULL::bigint
                        END AND lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(a.display_name, '<literal redacted>'::text), c.document_name)) ~ '<literal redacted>'::text AND a.archived_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
                  ORDER BY (COALESCE(c.fully_signed_date, c.date)) DESC NULLS LAST, c.id DESC
                 LIMIT 1) ct ON true
        ), resolved AS (
         SELECT b.learner_id,
            b.enrolment_id,
            b.profile_aptem_id,
            b.coach_email,
            b.programme_status,
            b.lifecycle_status,
            b.profile_planned_hours,
            b.profile_start_date,
            b.profile_end_date,
            b.profile_learner_start_date,
            b.profile_learner_end_date,
            b.source_aptem_id,
            b.source_planned_hours,
            b.source_start_date,
            b.source_end_date,
            b.source_learner_start_date,
            b.source_learner_end_date,
            b.source_apprenticeship_end_date,
            b.source_practical_end_date,
            b.snapshot_aptem_id,
            b.snapshot_planned_hours,
            b.snapshot_start_date,
            b.snapshot_end_date,
            b.snapshot_date,
            b.snapshot_target_hours,
            b.formula_version,
            b.calculation_method,
            b.calculated_by,
            b.calculated_at,
            b.updated_at,
            b.contract_training_plan_hours,
            b.contract_planned_hours,
            b.contract_start_date,
            b.contract_end_date,
            COALESCE(b.contract_training_plan_hours, b.contract_planned_hours, "Learner".target_hours_safe_numeric(b.source_planned_hours), b.profile_planned_hours, b.snapshot_planned_hours) AS resolved_planned_hours,
            COALESCE(b.contract_start_date, "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.source_start_date), "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.source_learner_start_date), b.profile_start_date, "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.profile_learner_start_date), b.snapshot_start_date) AS resolved_start_date,
            COALESCE(b.contract_end_date, "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.source_end_date), "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.source_learner_end_date), "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.source_apprenticeship_end_date), "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.source_practical_end_date), b.profile_end_date, "Learner".target_hours_safe_date(b.profile_learner_end_date), b.snapshot_end_date) AS resolved_end_date,
            lower(replace(replace(replace(btrim(COALESCE(NULLIF(b.programme_status::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(b.lifecycle_status::text, '<literal redacted>'::text))), '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text)) AS status_norm
           FROM base b
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT r.learner_id,
            r.enrolment_id,
            r.profile_aptem_id,
            r.coach_email,
            r.programme_status,
            r.lifecycle_status,
            r.profile_planned_hours,
            r.profile_start_date,
            r.profile_end_date,
            r.profile_learner_start_date,
            r.profile_learner_end_date,
            r.source_aptem_id,
            r.source_planned_hours,
            r.source_start_date,
            r.source_end_date,
            r.source_learner_start_date,
            r.source_learner_end_date,
            r.source_apprenticeship_end_date,
            r.source_practical_end_date,
            r.snapshot_aptem_id,
            r.snapshot_planned_hours,
            r.snapshot_start_date,
            r.snapshot_end_date,
            r.snapshot_date,
            r.snapshot_target_hours,
            r.formula_version,
            r.calculation_method,
            r.calculated_by,
            r.calculated_at,
            r.updated_at,
            r.contract_training_plan_hours,
            r.contract_planned_hours,
            r.contract_start_date,
            r.contract_end_date,
            r.resolved_planned_hours,
            r.resolved_start_date,
            r.resolved_end_date,
            r.status_norm,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.status_norm = '<literal redacted>'::text OR r.status_norm ~~ '<literal redacted>'::text THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
                    WHEN (r.status_norm = ANY (ARRAY['<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text])) AND r.resolved_planned_hours > 0::numeric AND r.resolved_start_date IS NOT NULL AND r.resolved_end_date IS NOT NULL AND r.resolved_end_date > r.resolved_start_date THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text
                END AS resolved_status
           FROM resolved r
        )
 SELECT learner_id,
    enrolment_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(profile_aptem_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(source_aptem_id, '<literal redacted>'::text)) ~ '<literal redacted>'::text THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(profile_aptem_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(source_aptem_id, '<literal redacted>'::text))::bigint
            ELSE snapshot_aptem_id
        END AS aptem_id,
    coach_email,
    CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date,
    snapshot_date,
    resolved_planned_hours::numeric(12,2) AS planned_hours,
    resolved_start_date AS start_date,
    resolved_end_date AS planned_end_date,
        CASE
            WHEN resolved_start_date IS NOT NULL AND resolved_end_date IS NOT NULL AND resolved_end_date > resolved_start_date THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - resolved_start_date, resolved_end_date - resolved_start_date))
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS elapsed_days,
        CASE
            WHEN resolved_start_date IS NOT NULL AND resolved_end_date IS NOT NULL AND resolved_end_date > resolved_start_date THEN resolved_end_date - resolved_start_date
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS programme_days,
        CASE
            WHEN resolved_status = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN "Learner".target_hours_as_of(resolved_planned_hours, resolved_start_date, resolved_end_date, CURRENT_DATE)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS target_hours,
    snapshot_target_hours,
    resolved_status AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN resolved_status = '<literal redacted>'::text AND CURRENT_DATE < resolved_start_date THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN resolved_status = '<literal redacted>'::text AND CURRENT_DATE >= resolved_end_date THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN resolved_status = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN status_norm = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN status_norm ~~ '<literal redacted>'::text THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN (status_norm = ANY (ARRAY['<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text])) AND (resolved_planned_hours IS NULL OR resolved_planned_hours <= 0::numeric) THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN status_norm = ANY (ARRAY['<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text]) THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text || COALESCE(status_norm, '<literal redacted>'::text)
        END AS status_reason,
    COALESCE(formula_version, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS formula_version,
    COALESCE(calculation_method, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS calculation_method,
    '<literal redacted>'::text AS source_system,
    (((('<literal redacted>'::text || learner_id::text) || '<literal redacted>'::text) || COALESCE(enrolment_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text)) || '<literal redacted>'::text) || COALESCE(source_aptem_id, profile_aptem_id::text, snapshot_aptem_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS source_reference,
    COALESCE(calculated_by, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS calculated_by,
    calculated_at,
    COALESCE(updated_at, now()) AS updated_at
   FROM classified;

definition:
SELECT c.id AS component_id,
    c.title AS component_title,
    c.type AS component_type,
    c.expected_otjh,
    c.points,
    c.ksb_mappings,
    c.reflection_required,
    c.workplace_evidence_required,
    c.tutor_validation_required,
    c.deleted_at AS component_deleted_at,
    c.deleted_by AS component_deleted_by,
    c.deleted_via_parent AS component_deleted_via_parent,
    w.id AS week_id,
    w.week_number,
    w.title AS week_title,
    w.deleted_at AS week_deleted_at,
    w.deleted_via_parent AS week_deleted_via_parent,
    m.module_catalogue_id,
    m.title AS module_title,
    m.group_id,
    m.group_name,
    m.cohort_id,
    m.cohort_name,
    m.programme_id,
    COALESCE(p.name, m.programme_name) AS programme_name,
    COALESCE(p.is_archived, false) AS programme_is_archived,
    p.deleted_at AS programme_deleted_at,
    c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR w.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR ch.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(c.is_programme_deleted, false) OR COALESCE(w.is_programme_deleted, false) OR COALESCE(m.is_programme_deleted, false) OR COALESCE(g.is_programme_deleted, false) OR COALESCE(ch.is_programme_deleted, false) OR COALESCE(p.is_archived, false) AS is_deleted
   FROM curriculum.components c
     LEFT JOIN curriculum.weeks w ON w.id::text = c.week_id::text
     LEFT JOIN curriculum.modules m ON m.module_catalogue_id::text = c.module_catalogue_id::text
     LEFT JOIN curriculum.groups g ON g.group_id::text = m.group_id::text
     LEFT JOIN curriculum.cohorts ch ON ch.cohort_id::text = m.cohort_id::text
     LEFT JOIN curriculum.programmes p ON p.programme_id::text = m.programme_id::text;

name: reviews
definition:
SELECT r.id::text AS id,
    r.aptem_review_id,
    r.review_data ->> '<literal redacted>'::text AS learner_id,
    lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.learner_email)) AS learner_email,
    r.learner_name,
        CASE
            WHEN r.review_type = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text
        END AS kind,
    r.review_type,
    r.reviewer_name,
        CASE
            WHEN r.status = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            ELSE r.status
        END AS status,
    r.extraction_status,
    r.last_seen_at,
    r.updated_at,
    COALESCE((r.planned_scheduled_date AT TIME ZONE '<literal redacted>'::text)::date,
        CASE

definition:
WITH slots AS (
         SELECT p_1."ID"::text AS learner_id,
            '<literal redacted>'::text AS kind,
            s.slot,
            to_jsonb(p_1.*) ->> ('<literal redacted>'::text || s.slot) AS raw_date,
            COALESCE(to_jsonb(p_1.*) ->> ('<literal redacted>'::text || s.slot), '<literal redacted>'::text) AS status
           FROM "LMS"."PR" p_1
             CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 16) s(slot)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p_1."ID"::text AS "ID",
            '<literal redacted>'::text,
            s.slot,
            to_jsonb(p_1.*) ->> ('<literal redacted>'::text || s.slot),
            COALESCE(to_jsonb(p_1.*) ->> ('<literal redacted>'::text || s.slot), '<literal redacted>'::text) AS "coalesce"
           FROM "LMS"."MCR" p_1
             CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 22) s(slot)
        ), parsed AS (
         SELECT slots.learner_id,
            slots.kind,
            slots.slot,
            slots.raw_date,
            slots.status,
                CASE
                    WHEN slots.raw_date ~ '<literal redacted>'::text AND "substring"(slots.raw_date, 4, 2)::integer >= 1 AND "substring"(slots.raw_date, 4, 2)::integer <= 12 AND "substring"(slots.raw_date, 1, 2)::integer >= 1 AND "substring"(slots.raw_date, 1, 2)::integer <= 31 THEN to_date(slots.raw_date, '<literal redacted>'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS planned_date
           FROM slots
        )
 SELECT l.learner_id,
    l.learner_name,
    l.learner_email,
    l.coach_name,
    l.coach_key,
    l.coach_source_id,
    l.learner_status,
    l.start_date,
    l.end_date,
    l.programme,
    p.kind,
    p.slot,
    (((p.kind || '<literal redacted>'::text) || p.learner_id) || '<literal redacted>'::text) || p.slot AS id,
    p.status,
    p.planned_date,
    p.raw_date,
    COALESCE(to_char(p.planned_date::timestamp with time zone, '<literal redacted>'::text) = p.raw_date, false) AS date_valid
   FROM parsed p
     JOIN kbc_coaching_reporting.learners l USING (learner_id)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.raw_date), '<literal redacted>'::text) IS NOT NULL;

name: attendance_roster

WITH unique_ids AS (

            min(learners.id) AS id
           FROM "Learner".learners
          WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM learners.email), '<literal redacted>'::text) IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM learners.email)))
         HAVING count(*) = 1
        ), joined AS (
         SELECT i.learner_id,
            i.learner_email,

    r.completed_day::text AS completed_day,

           FROM "Learner".learner_progress_entries
          WHERE learner_progress_entries.accepted = true AND learner_progress_entries.deleted_at IS NULL
        ), activity AS (
         SELECT p.learner_id,
            COALESCE(s_1.reporting_month, p.reporting_month) AS month,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN s_1.id IS NOT NULL THEN s_1.actual_seconds
                    ELSE p.actual_seconds
                END) / 3600.0 AS actual,
            max(p.ssot_updated_at) AS actual_updated_at
           FROM accepted p
             LEFT JOIN "Learner".learner_activity_reporting_segments s_1 ON s_1.progress_id = p.id
          WHERE COALESCE(s_1.reporting_month, p.reporting_month)::text ~ '<literal redacted>'::text AND COALESCE(s_1.reporting_month, p.reporting_month)::text < to_char(CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, '<literal redacted>'::text) AND (COALESCE(s_1.reporting_ended_at, p.reporting_ended_at) IS NULL OR COALESCE(s_1.reporting_ended_at, p.reporting_ended_at) <= now()) AND COALESCE(s_1.actual_seconds, p.actual_seconds) >= 0
          GROUP BY p.learner_id, (COALESCE(s_1.reporting_month, p.reporting_month))
        ), targets AS (
         SELECT learner_monthly_targets.learner_id,
            learner_monthly_targets.report_month AS month,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) = 1 AND min(learner_monthly_targets.target_hours) > 0::numeric THEN min(learner_monthly_targets.target_hours)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expected,
            max(learner_monthly_targets.updated_at) AS target_updated_at,
            string_agg(DISTINCT learner_monthly_targets.basis, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS target_basis
           FROM "Learner".learner_monthly_targets
          WHERE learner_monthly_targets.report_month::text ~ '<literal redacted>'::text
          GROUP BY learner_monthly_targets.learner_id, learner_monthly_targets.report_month
        ), attendance_unique AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (learner_attendance_details.learner_id, (COALESCE(learner_attendance_details.occurrence_id, learner_attendance_details.session_id))) learner_attendance_details.learner_id,
            learner_attendance_details.session_date,
            learner_attendance_details.attendance_status,
            learner_attendance_details.calculated_at
           FROM "Learner".learner_attendance_details
          WHERE learner_attendance_details.is_expected = true AND learner_attendance_details.session_date < CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(learner_attendance_details.occurrence_id, learner_attendance_details.session_id) IS NOT NULL AND (learner_attendance_details.attendance_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['<literal redacted>'::character varying, '<literal redacted>'::character varying, '<literal redacted>'::character varying]::text[]))
          ORDER BY learner_attendance_details.learner_id, (COALESCE(learner_attendance_details.occurrence_id, learner_attendance_details.session_id)), learner_attendance_details.calculated_at DESC NULLS LAST, learner_attendance_details.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, learner_attendance_details.id DESC
        ), attendance AS (
         SELECT attendance_unique.learner_id,
            to_char(attendance_unique.session_date::timestamp with time zone, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS month,
            count(*) AS sessions,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE attendance_unique.attendance_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['<literal redacted>'::character varying, '<literal redacted>'::character varying]::text[])) AS attended,
            max(attendance_unique.calculated_at) AS attendance_updated_at
           FROM attendance_unique
          GROUP BY attendance_unique.learner_id, (to_char(attendance_unique.session_date::timestamp with time zone, '<literal redacted>'::text))
        ), keys AS (
         SELECT activity.learner_id,
            activity.month
           FROM activity
        UNION
         SELECT targets.learner_id,
            targets.month
           FROM targets
        UNION
         SELECT attendance.learner_id,
            attendance.month
           FROM attendance
        )
 SELECT k.learner_id::text AS lms_id,
    k.month,
    a.actual::double precision AS actual,
    t.expected::double precision AS expected,
    t.target_basis,
    s.sessions::integer AS sessions,
    s.attended::integer AS attended,
    a.actual_updated_at,
    t.target_updated_at,
    s.attendance_updated_at
   FROM keys k
     LEFT JOIN activity a USING (learner_id, month)
     LEFT JOIN targets t USING (learner_id, month)
     LEFT JOIN attendance s USING (learner_id, month);

name: inclusion_plan_months
definition:
WITH unique_identity AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT learners.aptem_id,
            min(learners.id) AS lms_id
           FROM "Learner".learners
          WHERE learners.aptem_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY learners.aptem_id
         HAVING count(*) = 1
        ), identity AS (
         SELECT u.aptem_id,
            u.lms_id,
            l.programme_id,
            l.enrolment_id
           FROM unique_identity u
             JOIN "Learner".learners l ON l.id = u.lms_id
        ), imported AS (
         SELECT i.lms_id,
            j.key AS month,
                CASE
                    WHEN j.value ~ '<literal redacted>'::text THEN j.value::numeric
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expected,
            s.last_seen AS updated_at
           FROM identity i
             JOIN "Learner".source_lms_learners s USING (aptem_id)
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.planned_hours_monthly) = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN s.planned_hours_monthly
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>'::jsonb
                END) j(key, value)
          WHERE j.key ~ '<literal redacted>'::text
        ), scoped_targets AS (
         SELECT i.lms_id,
            t_1.report_month AS month,
            t_1.target_hours,
            t_1.updated_at
           FROM identity i
             JOIN "Learner".learner_monthly_targets t_1 ON t_1.learner_id = i.lms_id
          WHERE t_1.report_month::text ~ '<literal redacted>'::text AND (NULLIF(t_1.programme_id, '<literal redacted>'::text) IS NULL OR t_1.programme_id = i.programme_id::text) AND (t_1.enrolment_id IS NULL OR t_1.enrolment_id = i.enrolment_id) AND (COALESCE(t_1.programme_profile_id, '<literal redacted>'::text) = '<literal redacted>'::text OR NULLIF(t_1.programme_id, '<literal redacted>'::text) IS NOT NULL AND t_1.programme_id = i.programme_id::text)
        ), individual AS (
         SELECT scoped_targets.lms_id,
            scoped_targets.month,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) = 1 AND min(scoped_targets.target_hours) >= 0::numeric THEN min(scoped_targets.target_hours)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expected,
            max(scoped_targets.updated_at) AS updated_at
           FROM scoped_targets
          GROUP BY scoped_targets.lms_id, scoped_targets.month
        ), keys AS (
         SELECT imported.lms_id,
            imported.month
           FROM imported
        UNION
         SELECT individual.lms_id,
            individual.month
           FROM individual
        )
 SELECT k.lms_id::text AS lms_id,
    k.month,
        CASE
            WHEN t.lms_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.expected
            ELSE p.expected
        END::double precision AS expected,
        CASE
            WHEN t.lms_id IS NOT NULL AND t.expected IS NULL THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN t.lms_id IS NOT NULL THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text
        END AS target_basis,
        CASE
            WHEN t.lms_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.updated_at
            ELSE p.updated_at
        END AS target_updated_at
   FROM keys k
     LEFT JOIN imported p USING (lms_id, month)
     LEFT JOIN individual t USING (lms_id, month);

name: inclusion_time_progress
definition:
WITH boundary AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('<literal redacted>'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE '<literal redacted>'::text)) AS month_start
        ), actual AS (
         SELECT inclusion_time_monthly.lms_id,
            sum(inclusion_time_monthly.actual) AS hours,
            max(inclusion_time_monthly.actual_updated_at) AS updated_at
           FROM kbc_quality_reporting.inclusion_time_monthly
             CROSS JOIN boundary b_1
          WHERE inclusion_time_monthly.month::text < to_char(b_1.month_start, '<literal redacted>'::text)
          GROUP BY inclusion_time_monthly.lms_id
        ), due AS (
         SELECT inclusion_plan_months.lms_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE inclusion_plan_months.expected IS NULL) = 0 THEN sum(inclusion_plan_months.expected)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS hours,
            max(inclusion_plan_months.target_updated_at) AS updated_at,
            string_agg(DISTINCT inclusion_plan_months.target_basis, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS basis
           FROM kbc_quality_reporting.inclusion_plan_months
             CROSS JOIN boundary b_1
          WHERE inclusion_plan_months.month < to_char(b_1.month_start, '<literal redacted>'::text)
          GROUP BY inclusion_plan_months.lms_id
        ), plan_baseline AS (
         SELECT s_1.aptem_id
           FROM "Learner".source_lms_learners s_1
          WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM jsonb_each_text(
                        CASE
                            WHEN jsonb_typeof(s_1.planned_hours_monthly) = '<literal redacted>'::text THEN s_1.planned_hours_monthly
                            ELSE '<literal redacted>'::jsonb
                        END) j(key, value)
                  WHERE j.key ~ '<literal redacted>'::text))
        )
 SELECT r.learner_id,
    a.hours AS time_actual_hours,
        CASE
            WHEN pb.aptem_id IS NOT NULL AND d.hours > 0::double precision THEN d.hours
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS time_planned_to_date_hours,
        CASE
            WHEN s.planned_hours_total > 0::numeric THEN s.planned_hours_total::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS time_total_planned_hours,
        CASE
            WHEN pb.aptem_id IS NOT NULL AND d.hours > 0::double precision AND a.hours IS NOT NULL THEN 100::double precision * a.hours / d.hours
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS time_progress_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN s.planned_hours_total > 0::numeric AND a.hours IS NOT NULL THEN 100::double precision * a.hours / s.planned_hours_total::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS time_total_progress_pct,
    (b.month_start - '<literal redacted>'::interval)::date::text AS time_as_of,
    ('<literal redacted>'::text ||
        CASE
            WHEN pb.aptem_id IS NULL THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(d.basis, '<literal redacted>'::text)
        END) || '<literal redacted>'::text AS time_basis,
    d.updated_at AS time_plan_updated_at,
    a.updated_at AS time_actual_updated_at,
    s.last_seen AS time_total_plan_updated_at
   FROM kbc_quality_reporting.inclusion_roster_v2 r
     CROSS JOIN boundary b
     LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.lms_id = r.lms_id
     LEFT JOIN due d ON d.lms_id = r.lms_id
     LEFT JOIN "Learner".source_lms_learners s ON s.aptem_id::text = r.learner_id
     LEFT JOIN plan_baseline pb ON pb.aptem_id::text = r.learner_id;

name: otj_allocation_checks
definition:
WITH canonical AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.learner_id, (COALESCE(NULLIF(p.canonical_activity_key, '<literal redacted>'::text), '<literal redacted>'::text || p.id::text))) p.id,
            p.learner_id,
            p.actual_seconds,
            p.reporting_month,
            p.reporting_started_at,
            p.reporting_ended_at,
            p.ssot_updated_at
           FROM "Learner".learner_progress_entries p
             JOIN "Learner".learners l_1 ON l_1.id = p.learner_id
          WHERE p.accepted AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.aptem_id IS NULL OR l_1.aptem_id IS NULL OR p.aptem_id = l_1.aptem_id) AND (NULLIF(p.programme_id, '<literal redacted>'::text) IS NULL OR NULLIF(l_1.programme_id::text, '<literal redacted>'::text) IS NULL OR p.programme_id = l_1.programme_id::text) AND (p.enrolment_id IS NULL OR l_1.enrolment_id IS NULL OR p.enrolment_id = l_1.enrolment_id)
          ORDER BY p.learner_id, (COALESCE(NULLIF(p.canonical_activity_key, '<literal redacted>'::text), '<literal redacted>'::text || p.id::text)), p.ssot_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.id DESC
        ), units AS (
         SELECT p.id AS progress_id,
            p.learner_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.actual_seconds
                    ELSE p.actual_seconds
                END AS seconds,
            COALESCE(s.reporting_month, p.reporting_month) AS month,
            COALESCE(s.reporting_started_at, p.reporting_started_at) AS started_at,
            COALESCE(s.reporting_ended_at, p.reporting_ended_at) AS ended_at,
            GREATEST(p.ssot_updated_at, s.updated_at) AS updated_at
           FROM canonical p
             LEFT JOIN "Learner".learner_activity_reporting_segments s ON s.progress_id = p.id AND s.learner_id = p.learner_id
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT units.progress_id,
            units.learner_id,
            units.seconds,
            units.month,
            units.started_at,
            units.ended_at,
            units.updated_at,
            NOT COALESCE(units.month::text ~ '<literal redacted>'::text, false) AS month_unallocated,
            COALESCE(units.started_at > now() OR units.ended_at > now(), false) AS future_dated
           FROM units
        ), checks AS (
         SELECT classified.learner_id,
            count(DISTINCT classified.progress_id) FILTER (WHERE classified.month_unallocated AND classified.seconds >= 0) AS unallocated_activity_count,
            COALESCE(sum(classified.seconds) FILTER (WHERE classified.month_unallocated AND classified.seconds >= 0), 0::numeric) AS known_unallocated_seconds,
            count(DISTINCT classified.progress_id) FILTER (WHERE classified.seconds IS NULL) AS missing_duration_activity_count,
            count(DISTINCT classified.progress_id) FILTER (WHERE classified.seconds < 0) AS invalid_duration_activity_count,
            count(DISTINCT classified.progress_id) FILTER (WHERE classified.month_unallocated AND classified.seconds >= 0 AND classified.future_dated) AS future_dated_unallocated_activity_count,
            max(classified.updated_at) AS allocation_checked_source_updated_at
           FROM classified
          GROUP BY classified.learner_id
        )
 SELECT l.id::text AS lms_id,
    COALESCE(c.unallocated_activity_count, 0::bigint) AS unallocated_activity_count,
    COALESCE(c.known_unallocated_seconds, 0::numeric) AS known_unallocated_seconds,
    COALESCE(c.missing_duration_activity_count, 0::bigint) AS missing_duration_activity_count,
    COALESCE(c.invalid_duration_activity_count, 0::bigint) AS invalid_duration_activity_count,
    COALESCE(c.future_dated_unallocated_activity_count, 0::bigint) AS future_dated_unallocated_activity_count,
    c.allocation_checked_source_updated_at
   FROM "Learner".learners l
     LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.learner_id = l.id;

name: combined_attendance_source
definition:
WITH legacy AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT lower(btrim(k."Email")) AS raw_email,
            k.date AS session_date,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(k.module), '<literal redacted>'::text), k.lecture_name))), '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS module_key,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(k.module), '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(btrim(k.lecture_name), '<literal redacted>'::text)) AS module_name,
            NULLIF(btrim(k."FullName"), '<literal redacted>'::text) AS learner_name,
            k."ID" AS aptem_id,
            k.key AS record_key,
            to_jsonb(k.*) AS payload,
                CASE
                    WHEN k."Attendance" = 1 THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
                    WHEN k."Attendance" = 0 THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text
                END AS status
           FROM kbc_sync.kbc_attendance k
        ), lms_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT a.id,
            a.learner_profile_id,
            a.occurrence_id,
            lower(btrim(a.learner_email::text)) AS raw_email,
            o.scheduled_start::date AS session_date,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(s.module_title)), '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text) AS module_key,
            s.module_title AS module_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(a.learner_name::text), '<literal redacted>'::text), NULLIF(btrim(l.full_name), '<literal redacted>'::text)) AS learner_name,
            l.aptem_id,
            to_jsonb(a.*) || jsonb_build_object('<literal redacted>', l.aptem_id, '<literal redacted>', o.scheduled_start::date, '<literal redacted>', s.module_title) AS payload,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(btrim(a.attendance_status::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['<literal redacted>'::text, '<literal redacted>'::text]) THEN lower(btrim(a.attendance_status::text))
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text
                END AS status
           FROM curriculum.live_session_learner_attendance a
             JOIN curriculum.live_session_occurrences o ON o.id::text = a.occurrence_id::text
             JOIN curriculum.live_sessions s ON s.id::text = a.live_session_id::text
             LEFT JOIN "Learner".learners l ON l.id = a.learner_profile_id
        ), lms AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(m.raw_email, a.raw_email) AS learner_email,
            a.raw_email,
            a.session_date,
            a.module_key,
            a.module_name,
            a.learner_name,
            a.aptem_id,
            a.learner_profile_id,
            a.occurrence_id,
            a.id::text AS record_key,
            a.payload,
            a.status
           FROM lms_raw a
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT k.raw_email
                   FROM legacy k
                  WHERE k.aptem_id = a.aptem_id AND k.session_date = a.session_date AND k.module_key = a.module_key
                  ORDER BY (k.raw_email = a.raw_email) DESC, k.raw_email
                 LIMIT 1) m ON true
        ), all_records AS (
         SELECT '<literal redacted>'::text AS source,
            legacy.raw_email AS learner_email,
            legacy.raw_email,
            legacy.session_date,
            legacy.module_key,
            legacy.module_name,
            legacy.learner_name,
            legacy.aptem_id,
            NULL::bigint AS learner_profile_id,
            NULL::text AS occurrence_id,
            legacy.record_key,
            legacy.payload,
            legacy.status
           FROM legacy
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '<literal redacted>'::text,
            lms.learner_email,
            lms.raw_email,
            lms.session_date,
            lms.module_key,
            lms.module_name,
            lms.learner_name,
            lms.aptem_id,
            lms.learner_profile_id,
            lms.occurrence_id,
            lms.record_key,
            lms.payload,
            lms.status
           FROM lms
        )
 SELECT learner_email,
    session_date,
    module_key,
    COALESCE(min(module_name) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text), min(module_name) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text)) AS module_name,
    COALESCE(min(learner_name) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text), min(learner_name) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text)) AS learner_name,
    COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(record_key, payload) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text), '<literal redacted>'::jsonb) AS legacy_records,
    COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(record_key, payload) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text), '<literal redacted>'::jsonb) AS lms_records,
    COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT aptem_id ORDER BY aptem_id) FILTER (WHERE aptem_id IS NOT NULL), '<literal redacted>'::bigint[]) AS aptem_ids,
    COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT learner_profile_id ORDER BY learner_profile_id) FILTER (WHERE learner_profile_id IS NOT NULL), '<literal redacted>'::bigint[]) AS lms_profile_ids,
    COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT occurrence_id ORDER BY occurrence_id) FILTER (WHERE occurrence_id IS NOT NULL), '<literal redacted>'::text[]) AS lms_occurrence_ids,
    COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT raw_email ORDER BY raw_email) FILTER (WHERE raw_email IS NOT NULL), '<literal redacted>'::text[]) AS learner_emails,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text)::integer AS legacy_record_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = '<literal redacted>'::text)::integer AS lms_record_count,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(status = '<literal redacted>'::text) AND bool_or(status = '<literal redacted>'::text) THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN bool_or(status = '<literal redacted>'::text) THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            WHEN bool_or(status = '<literal redacted>'::text) THEN '<literal redacted>'::text
            ELSE '<literal redacted>'::text
        END AS attendance_result,
    count(DISTINCT aptem_id) > 1 AS identity_conflict
   FROM all_records
  WHERE learner_email IS NOT NULL AND learner_email <> '<literal redacted>'::text AND session_date IS NOT NULL AND module_key IS NOT NULL AND module_key <> '<literal redacted>'::text
  GROUP BY learner_email, session_date, module_key;

name: ingestion_source_summary
definition:
SELECT run.run_id,
    run.source_system,
    run.entity_scope,
    run.status,
    run.expected_count,
    run.received_count,
    run.unique_count,
    run.stored_count,
    run.duplicate_count,
    run.rejected_count,
    count(DISTINCT raw.record_id)::integer AS raw_records,
    count(DISTINCT activity.activity_id)::integer AS activities,
    count(DISTINCT issue.issue_id) FILTER (WHERE issue.resolved_at IS NULL)::integer AS open_issues
   FROM khaled_learning_hub.ingestion_runs run
     LEFT JOIN khaled_learning_hub.raw_source_records raw ON raw.run_id = run.run_id
     LEFT JOIN khaled_learning_hub.activities activity ON activity.run_id = run.run_id
     LEFT JOIN khaled_learning_hub.ingestion_issues issue ON issue.run_id = run.run_id
  GROUP BY run.run_id, run.source_system, run.entity_scope, run.status, run.expected_count, run.received_count, run.unique_count, run.stored_count, run.duplicate_count, run.rejected_count;
